items.title: 鍾健禮對卵巢錯誤切除事件深表痛心及遺憾 對病人及家屬致歉
items.summary: 一名45歲女病人在中大醫院接受接受腹腔鏡子宮及雙側輸卵管切除手術期間，兩邊卵巢亦被錯誤切除。中大醫院行政總裁鍾健禮對事件深表痛心及遺憾，對病人及家屬致以慰問及歉意。 他在記者會表示，涉事的是駐院合約婦產科醫生，很有經驗亦有口碑。事發當晚，他曾與涉事醫生通電話，對方承認做錯。鍾健禮說，院方不便透露如何處分，但強調會向病人交代。病人目前情況穩定，會免費獲得治療及跟進。…
items.titleEn: Chong Ki-jeong apologizes to the patients and their families for the mistaken removal of the ovary
items.summaryEn: A 45-year-old female patient was admitted to the Central General Hospital for surgery to remove the uterus and the ovaries from both sides of the uterine tube, and both ovaries were removed incorrectly. The president of the Central High Hospital, Chung-hee, expressed deep sorrow and regret for the incident and expressed his condolences and apologies to the patients and their families. He told a press conference that the patient was a contracted gynecologist in hospital, with a lot of experience and a good reputation. The incident occurred that evening when he called the doctor involved and they confessed to his mistake. In a statement, Chong said that the hospital was not able to disclose how it was handled, but emphasized that it would be handed over to the patients. In the meantime, patients are now stable and will receive free treatment and follow-up. I'm not sure.

items.title: 有議員倡小型工程納入強制呈報要求 孫玉菡稱勞工處亦會加強巡查
items.summary: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡表示，過去5年間，錄得超過50宗涉及裝修及維修工程的致命工業意外，其中24宗在意外發生前有向勞工處呈報或當局已知悉有關工程。自去年起，相關工程的呈報比例顯著上升，截至本月初，有關比例約為6成。 有立法會議員建議，將包括吊棚的小型工程納入為強制呈報的要求。孫玉菡說，除了呈報，勞工處亦會加強巡查及其他相關工作。 編輯：黃佩珊
items.titleEn: Some lawmakers advocate for forced filing of small-scale projects, and Sun Yat-sen says the Department of Labor will also step up inspections
items.summaryEn: In the last five years, over 50 deadly industrial accidents involving repair and maintenance work have been recorded, with 24 reported to the Department of Labor or authorities prior to the accident, according to the Directorate of Labor and Welfare, Sun Yue. Since last year, the proportion of projects reported has increased significantly, reaching about 6% as of the beginning of this month. Some lawmakers have suggested that small projects, including hanging sheds, be submitted for compulsory filing. In addition to reporting, the Ministry of Labor will also step up inspections and other related work. Editor's Note: This is the last post

items.title: 花旗：本港千萬富翁人數較16年前增長約兩倍
items.summary: 花旗最新報告推算，截止今年中，本港千萬富翁人口約41.2萬人，較去年增加約5000人。當中流動資產中位數達5000萬元的準億萬富翁偏好持有基金，以涉獵更多市場及一籃子股票。 花旗香港客戶策略及銷售管理主管成靜雯表示，千萬富翁人數較16年前增長約2倍，反映香港作為環球金融城市和財富管理中心的韌性和靈活性。…
items.titleEn: Flag: The number of millionaires in Hong Kong has nearly doubled from 16 years ago
items.summaryEn: According to the latest reports of the flag, the population of Hong Kong's billionaires is estimated to be around 412 thousand as of this year, an increase of about 5000 people from last year. In the meantime, billionaires with a median current assets of 50 million yuan prefer to hold funds to hunt for more markets and a ton of stocks. The head of customer strategy and sales management at Flag of Hong Kong, Cheng Cheng said that the number of millionaires has nearly doubled from 16 years ago, reflecting Hong Kong's robustness and flexibility as a global financial city and wealth management hub. items.title: 皇崗口岸開通至本月中日均出入境旅客約8.8萬人次
items.summary: 署理保安局局長卓孝業表示，重建後的皇崗口岸自上月12日開通至本月15日，整體運作大致暢順。日均出入境旅客約8.8萬人次，較以往落馬洲管制站增加超過一倍；周末及假期的日均出入境旅客則約14.2萬人次。針對開通初期在個別周末、節假日及深宵時段出現的跨境人流及車流高峰，當局一直密切監察情況，與深圳方面保持緊密溝通，持續檢視和優化各項口岸運作及交通配套安排。…
items.titleEn: The Royal Port of Singapore has been open since mid-March, with about 88,000 passengers entering the country.
items.summaryEn: Chief Security Officer Tsuyoshi Hyo said that the rebuilt port of Karachi was open from 12th to 15th of this month, and the overall operation has been pretty smooth. It is estimated that around 88,000 daily arrivals from the Malaysian border crossing station have more than doubled the number of arrivals, compared to about 142,000 on weekends and holidays. The authorities have been closely monitoring cross-border passenger and traffic flows during the early opening days, particularly on weekends, holidays and late nights, keeping in close contact with Shenzhen and continuing to monitor and optimize port operations and transport support arrangements. items.summaryEn: The executive director of the APEC Business Leaders Summit in Shenzhen, Li Keqiang, is holding a bilateral meeting with Vietnamese President Suriname in Shenzhen. During his visit to Vietnam in 2024, Li mentioned that the two sides reached 30 memoranda of understanding on cooperation covering different areas, and the two countries exchanged more frequently. items.titleEn: A 38-year-old man infected with polio is stable
items.summaryEn: The Centre for the Prevention of Tuberculosis is investigating a case involving a 38-year-old man who developed a cold and fatigue that began on 11 November and was followed by pain in his stomach. He was taken to Elizabeth Hospital for treatment in isolation, where his condition is stable. After his clinical trial, he tested positive for the Zika virus. According to the patient's information, he was in high-risk contact with a man he met via social media platforms outside Hong Kong during his time in hiding. The Centre is continuing its epidemiological investigation into the case and will notify the World Wildlife Fund about it. I'm not sure.

items.titleEn: The government is pushing for lowering the limit on the number of individual users who can register their mobile savings cards, and plans to consult them as soon as possible in the coming months.
items.summaryEn: The social welfare legislator Chen Xinwei was concerned that some people were handing over registered phone cards to a fraud group in different ways. Chanbury, Director of the Office of Business and Economic Development, said that the government is recommending criminalising certain inappropriate use of smartphone cards, such as providing personal information for the purpose of registering other people's phone cards without legal authorization or reason, and buying, selling, renting and otherwise providing or obtaining registered phone cards. In response to an oral questionnaire in the legislature, Chennai said that the government is recommending a reduction in the number of personal storage cards registered by individual users, from now on, to the maximum number of registrations per telcos.
